title: Artifact manifest reconciler and LTS-channel tagging for GPU stacks
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: implement an artifact manifest reconciler and LTS-aware tagging scheme that ties container image manifests, SBOM deltas, and GPU driver/CUDA ABI bundles into a single verifiable release unit. This ticket covers: (1) a reconciliation service that validates manifests produced by CI against a channel registry, (2) deterministic LTS tagging and channel metadata embedded in image annotations, (3) a lightweight ABI signature store for pinned GPU bundles, and (4) rollout gate hooks that the Console can call to block or allow a channel promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler verifies image manifest digest, SBOM delta, and kernel/driver bundle hash and marks the artifact as 'channel-ready' in the registry
Images published to the LTS channel have stable annotations: channel=lts/<version>, abi-hash=<hex>, sbom-delta=<sha256>
Rollout gate API exposes: /v1/gate/check -> returns pass/fail and reason; Console uses this to allow canary -> stable promotions
Automated rollback triggered when gate-check fails post-promotion (integration test validates behavior)
Documented runbook and Confluence spec linked in ticket
approach: Create a small reconciler service (Go) that consumes CI artifact events, resolves the manifest set (image + sbom + gpu-bundle), computes deterministic hashes, and writes a channel record to the channel registry. Add a gating webhook that verifies signatures and ABI consistency before allowing promotion. Integrate lightweight verification into the Dedicated deployment pipeline and add traceable events to Console telemetry for post-mortem analysis.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: ABI mismatch could silently pass if hashes are not comprehensive -> Mitigation: include combined kernel/driver symbol-level fingerprint and sample inference smoke tests
Risk: SBOM formats vary across build systems -> Mitigation: implement SBOM normalization step and delta comparator, fail-fast on unknown formats
Risk: Rollout gate adds latency to promotions -> Mitigation: gate runs asynchronously with a short(30s) optimistic timeout, Console will show 'pending validation' state
rollout_plan: Phase 1: non-blocking auditor mode (2 weeks) where reconciler annotates artifacts but does not block promotions. Phase 2: enable gate for canary promotions only. Phase 3: full LTS channel enforcement and automatic rollback on gate failures. Each phase tied to runtime-1.20 canaries in us-west1.
observability_requirements: Add gate event logs (artifact_key, gate_result, failure_reason) to Console traces. Create a Prometheus metric reconciler_failures_total and an SLO dashboard for gate validation latency.
